_occasion_share_comment: This source's allowance in every consumer's occasion index (Morgan, 2026-09-29, strength: decided): build_views refuses to build this source when its own catalogue's index is over it, and a consumer's cap is the sum of the allowances of the sources it declares. Measured 2026-09-29 at about 210; set at that plus about 40%, since this set is small and a single new practice is a large share of it.
_comment: This file is what makes the directory a practice-set source: its
name is chosen once, here, and every consumer declares it verbatim.
The repository holding it may be called anything. `subject` is a
sentence saying what the set is about; `code` lists directories
a consumer vendors alongside the practices (tools/, for a set
whose practices are about a tool it ships).
